messages.subject: semTools with imputed data
parts:
Dear list,
 
I am trying to use fit a growth model using lavaan. The were missing values in the data set, they were imputed by MICE. The semTools was used to employ the imputed data sets into the growth model by using the runMI function. In the semTools manual (P.51), there was a description:
 
miPackage Package to be used for imputation. Currently these functions only support
"Amelia" or "mice" for imputation
 
However, when I tried to use the runMI, I got the following error:
 
> imp=mice(ex115,m=5,print=F)
> model='
+ i =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4
+ s =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4
+ # regressions
+ i ~ x1 + x2
+ s ~ x1 + x2'
> out=runMI(model,data=imp$imputations,miPackage="mice",fun="growth")
Error in list(mice, data = data, m = m, diagnostics = FALSE, printFlag = FALSE) : 
  'm' is missing
 
So how could I use the imputed data sets in the right way? Thank you very much.
 
Best regards,
 
 
ya

model.syntax <- '
